concerns.text: Phase 8 (Tasks T048-T052) introduces 'Nash Equilibrium', 'Minimax-Optimal Response', and 'Utility Functions' which are absent from spec.md and violate FR-006 (strict associational framing). This is a semantic weakening of the constitutional constraint against causal/game-theoretic claims.

Task T026 implements an 'Outcome Permutation Test' (shuffling outcome), but spec.md FR-004 and US-3 explicitly mandate a 'residual permutation test'. The plan's rejection of residual permutation contradicts the spec's functional requirement without a documented spec amendment.

Task T022 (Weighted Linear Regression) incorrectly cites FR-004 (Permutation Test) as a requirement. FR-004 belongs to US-3/Robustness, not US-2/Modeling. This is a traceability error that obscures the actual requirements for the regression task.

Task T015 specifies outputting to 'diversity_scores.parquet', but spec.md US-1 Acceptance Scenario 1 explicitly requires 'output JSON'. This is a silent relaxation of the data interface contract defined in the spec.

Task T028 requires verifying 'p-value < 0.05 for at least 2/3 of sweep points' and reporting pass/fail. Spec.md SC-002 defines this as a measurement against the sweep, not a binary pass/fail gate. Adding a pass/fail logic introduces a new acceptance criterion not present in the spec.

Task T043 (Baseline_Interest_Vector Assumption) is duplicated in ID (also T043 in Phase 8). This ID collision creates ambiguity in traceability and violates the requirement for unique task identifiers.
